title: Head bounds over a bounded number of steps
statement: Let $M$ be a Boolean Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, and let $c$ be a configuration on input $x$. If every work-tape head of $c$ lies in $[-A,A]$ and $t\le B$, then every work-tape head after $t$ steps lies in $[-(A+B),A+B]$.
